params.description: Start date for the usage period (ISO 8601 format). Defaults to 30 days ago. Must be within the last 6 months (180 days).

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date for the usage period (ISO 8601 format). Defaults to current time.

params.description: Time granularity for grouping results. Currently reserved for future enhancements and does not change the response shape. Defaults to 'day'.
